model_dirs.32B: directory of the pinned Qwen3-32B files
model_dirs.14B: directory of the pinned Qwen3-14B files
model_dirs.8B: edge only: directory of the pinned Qwen3-8B files

gpu_uuid: edge: GPU-... of its GPU. server: null in the template; select-gpu writes the pinned copy
token_file: the experiment's own token for the REMOTE wire, mode 0600. The server preflight creates it; the edge gets a copy
workload_private: edge: the pinned private workload file (prompts and gold answers). server: null
hash_cache: a file of the experiment's own in which checkpoint hashes are cached
